recommendation_1: Replace the single linear layer with a two-layer fully connected network by changing `self.fc1 = nn.Linear(input_dim, mid_dim)` and `self.fc = nn.Linear(mid_dim, num_classes)` to use `mid_dim=256` instead of 100
rationale_1: A wider hidden layer increases model capacity to capture more complex patterns in the MNIST dataset, especially important given the non-IID nature where some clients have skewed class distributions.
recommendation_2: Change the activation function from ReLU to Swish by replacing `F.relu(self.fc1(x))` with `F.swish(self.fc1(x))`
rationale_2: Swish activation has been shown to outperform ReLU in many deep learning tasks including image classification, offering smoother gradients and better convergence properties.
recommendation_5: Use a different optimizer such as AdamW instead of SGD with momentum by changing `optimizer = torch.optim.SGD(net.parameters(), lr=lr, momentum=0.9)` to `optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(net.parameters(), lr=lr, weight_decay=1e-4)`
rationale_5: AdamW combines adaptive learning rates with decoupled weight decay, often providing faster convergence and better performance than SGD, especially useful in FL scenarios with heterogeneous data.
